zh: ECDSA：FIPS 186-5 规定的椭圆曲线数字签名算法。
domain parameters：签名与验证必须一致使用的那组曲线与基点参数。
X9.62：ECDSA 最早的 ANSI 标准出处，已被撤回。
deterministic variant：把签名用的随机数改为确定化生成的 ECDSA 变体。
assurance of possession：确信实体持有私钥及相关密钥材料。
security level：签名算法与其参数对应的强度等级。
en: ECDSA: the elliptic curve digital signature algorithm specified by FIPS 186-5.
Domain parameters: the curve and base-point set that signing and verification must share.
X9.62: the withdrawn ANSI standard where ECDSA was first specified.
Deterministic variant: the ECDSA variant that replaces the signature random value with a derived one.
Assurance of possession: confidence that an entity holds the private key and associated material.
Security level: the strength tier an algorithm and its parameters are rated at.
